tooltip.earth_magic.notebook.use: Right-click to open the magic handbook: starter route, mana, arcane stations and JEI lookup.
tooltip.earth_magic.notebook.scope: Independent magic branch: content replication, not survival difficulty simulation.
tooltip.earth_magic.arcane_initiation_no: Starter magic study: organizes observable magic into the shared mana value.
Right-click to unlock aether attunement. Once researched, it opens the arcane panel without resolving a cycle.
tooltip.earth_magic.arcane_body_ward_not: Starter arcane body ward: stable magic buffers environment stress and fatigue.
Requires arcane initiation. First use unlocks the body-ward circuit; later uses open the panel.
tooltip.earth_magic.arcane_breath_ward_n: Water breathing attunement: magic maintains breathing rhythm and extends underwater air.
Requires arcane initiation. First use unlocks the breathing circuit; later uses open the panel.
tooltip.earth_magic.material.route: Magic material used in crafting, alchemy, rune carving, ritual conversion and JEI lookup.
tooltip.earth_magic.block.route: Arcane station: right-click to open the screen, insert material, and attune or convert it with local aether.
tooltip.earth_magic.arcane_focus_mat: Portable attunement aid: sit for full circuit efficiency, extra aether gathering and continuous focus. The configurable panel key also works without a mat.
tooltip.earth_magic.alchemy_table: Blends arcane dust, mana salts, aether glass and other basic magical materials.
tooltip.earth_magic.rune_carving_table: Carves rune ink into copper plates, stone and ritual parts.
tooltip.earth_magic.ritual_pedestal: Center anchor for small rituals. It works alone, but a 3x3 ritual circle strengthens it.
tooltip.earth_magic.machine.alchemy_tabl: Converts arcane dust, aether crystals and glowstone dust into mana salt, aether glass and starter arcane dust.
tooltip.earth_magic.machine.rune_carving: Processes rune ink, rune copper plates and ritual chalk into rune parts and ward notes.
tooltip.earth_magic.machine.ritual_pedes: Uses local aether to activate cores, salts and aether glass. A four-corner crystal circle with side marks works faster.
tooltip.earth_magic.aether_crystal_clust: An aether crystallization node that raises the nearby field, suitable for alchemy areas and ritual circles.
tooltip.earth_magic.arcane_dust: A basic powder made by treating redstone, glowstone and amethyst as observable magic carriers.
tooltip.earth_magic.rune_ink: Conductive ink for stable rune writing.
tooltip.earth_magic.ritual_chalk: Marks ritual boundaries and node positions.
tooltip.earth_magic.crystallized_mana_sa: Low-tier mana salt that stores weak magical charge.
tooltip.earth_magic.aether_glass: Transparent material that can hold weak aether flow.
tooltip.earth_magic.rune_copper_plate: Copper conductivity combined with rune ink.
tooltip.earth_magic.aether_crystal: Stable magic-gathering crystal for ritual cores.
tooltip.earth_magic.dormant_ritual_core: Reusable ritual catalyst: place it with mana salt on the Ritual Pedestal to grow aether crystals. The core is not consumed.
guide.earth_magic.line1: Positioning: independent magic branch. Magic is learnable, craftable and engineerable.
guide.earth_magic.line2: Start: craft this notebook from one dirt, any planks or any stone.
guide.earth_magic.line3: Base: redstone + glowstone dust + amethyst shard => arcane dust.
guide.earth_magic.line4: Stations: alchemy blends, rune carving writes, ritual pedestal anchors.
guide.earth_magic.line5: Compatibility: this mod runs alone and uses optional dependencies, shared mana keys and material routes for the Earth mod ecosystem.
guide.earth_magic.line6: Mana: magic and qi share one mana value. If Xuanhuan is also trained, both bonuses add up.
guide.earth_magic.line7: This is an in-development test build; recipes and values will change.

lore.earth_magic.mag.arcane_initiation.d: Establish a basic magic circuit and attune local aether into shared mana, unlocking Aether Pulse and ward notes.
lore.earth_magic.mag.arcane_research_2.d: Deepen circuit theory and aether conduction analysis, laying the foundation for foci and higher schools.
lore.earth_magic.mag.arcane_research_3.d: Master high-density mana projection structures, unlocking Evocation Notes.
lore.earth_magic.mag.arcane_research_4.d: Analyze light refraction and cognitive interference circuits, unlocking Illusion Notes.
lore.earth_magic.mag.arcane_research_5.d: Formulate spatial anchoring equations in dense aether fields, unlocking Translocation Notes.
lore.earth_magic.mag.aether_crystals.des: Study aether crystals, shards and arcane dust, unlocking crystal charging and field notebooks.
lore.earth_magic.mag.body_ward.desc: Weave a close-fitting arcane ward that buffers impact and fatigue, unlocking the Body Ward school.
lore.earth_magic.mag.breath_ward.desc: Sustain respiratory rhythm with mana for underwater breathing, unlocking the Breath Ward school.
lore.earth_magic.mag.rune_carving.desc: Prepare rune ink and carve conducting circuits onto copper plates and rune stones, unlocking the Rune Carving Table.
lore.earth_magic.mag.rune_combination.de: Master the inscription, tier upgrading and three-slot synergy of Power, Guard, Flow and Bind runes.
lore.earth_magic.mag.jade_runes.desc: Combine nephrite and jadeite resonance with rune carving to craft tier-4 Jade Runes and Jade Focus Housings.
lore.earth_magic.mag.gem_socketing.desc: Socket cut gems into Arcane Foci to amplify spell damage, duration and range based on gem species and grade.
lore.earth_magic.mag.rituals.desc: Arrange ritual pedestals, candles, offering bowls and chalk markers at night to channel high-energy aether.
lore.earth_magic.mag.foci_and_scrolls.de: Craft Arcane Foci, Spell Scrolls and Focus Mats, enabling custom spell graph execution.
lore.earth_magic.mag.familiars.desc: Calm and bind Aether Foxes, Runebound Wolves and Mana Wisps using arcane dust and Familiar Contracts.
lore.earth_magic.mag.evocation.desc: Project Arcane Missiles at targets ahead; requires a focus fitted with a tier 2+ Power Rune.
lore.earth_magic.mag.illusion.desc: Bend aether to weave mirror images and conceal yourself; requires a focus fitted with a tier 2+ Flow Rune.
lore.earth_magic.mag.translocation.desc: Fold local aether for short-range line-of-sight blink; requires a focus fitted with a tier 3+ Flow Rune.
lore.earth_magic.mag.alchemy.desc: Refine Crystallized Mana Salt and Aether Glass in temperature-controlled Alchemy Tables.
lore.earth_magic.mag.aether_storage.desc: Build Aether Lenses, Aether Conduits and high-capacity Aether Batteries for arcane energy storage.
lore.earth_magic.mag.constructs.desc: Awaken Construct Cores in formed rituals to summon Contract Golems that share incoming damage.
lore.earth_magic.mag.aether_sensing.desc: Discern mineral, jade and alchemical properties directly through aether resonance without external sciences.
lore.earth_magic.mag.magic_mastery.desc: Master all six arcane schools, jade runes, gem socketing and constructs to unlock heirloom-grade magic creations.
